title: Lesson 9: CAP & Consistency Models — js-tools
desc: P is not a choice; PACELC is the half of the problem you meet daily; the consistency spectrum with its measured price; R+W>N gives exactly 0 stale reads while R+W=N still gives 33%; read-repair does nothing for the first read but turns a permanent 33% into 0%; last-write-wins loses data silently when clocks skew by 50 ms; and a real partition made the first request hang for 30 seconds with no error at all.
